context.exploration_scope: Change detection vs. E40's recorded baseline (not a re-derivation of E35..E40's already-known findings); reacts only to a genuinely new discrepancy

problem: E40 declared EVOLUTION_STABLE, but Evolution's ability to correctly react WHEN a real project change actually occurs (as opposed to confirming continued stability) had not itself been exercised.

decision.decision_summary: Compared E40's recorded baseline against a fresh current read across goals/capabilities/trace-chains/priority-ranking plus Goal<->Capability integrity and Currency readiness. Changes found: 0. Conclusion: NO_NEW_EVOLUTION_FOUND. 0 candidates.

action.action_summary: Fresh-read comparison against E40's own recorded baseline, not a full re-derivation; Gate evaluated only if a real change was found; 0 code modifications this run.

result.note: No real project change has occurred since E40 -- correctly concluded NO_NEW_EVOLUTION_FOUND rather than fabricating a reaction.

cause.root_cause_summary: E40 verified stability as of its own moment in time; a change-detection pass comparing against that specific baseline (rather than re-deriving everything from scratch) had not yet been exercised as its own real capability.

lesson: Comparing against a named, specific prior baseline (E40's own recorded snapshot) rather than re-running the full stability check is a distinct, real capability from either "verify current state" (E37/E39) or "verify integrated stability" (E40) -- it is what actually detects DRIFT, which neither of those directly measures.
